Couple Relationship

  • CURIE: gmeow:CoupleRelationship
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CoupleRelationship
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/genealogy

A reified couple relationship (marriage, civil union, or partnership) between two persons; bears marriage, divorce and related events.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:KinRelationship

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CoupleRelationship as a specialized kind of gmeow:KinRelationship. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
